fields.description:
RF-15 (new): Reactivate Button (Clear Ban/Pause)

A single Reactivate action on the Referrer record that reverses either a Ban or a Pause in one step — clears the relevant reason/notes fields and returns Referrer Status to Active.

AUTOMATION

* Trigger: Ops/Admin clicks Reactivate on a Referrer currently at Status = Banned or Paused.

* Clears whichever of Ban Reason, Ban Notes, and Pause Reason are populated.

Sets Referrer Status = Active.

IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENTS

*  NEW screen flow + button, same pattern as the existing Ban button (BUILD-232/BUILD-196): confirmation step, finish button to close the flow.
*  Restrict visibility to Ops/Admin users only — reps do not see this button, same restriction model as the Ban action.
*  Turn on Field History Tracking on Referrer Status (and other high-value fields — financial fields, email — max 20 fields per object) so reactivations and prior bans/pauses are auditable.
*  Add the History related list to the page layout (e.g. under a "More Info" tab) — it is a separate related list that must be added manually, not a dynamic related list.
*  Ban Notes is long text, so field history tracking will show that it changed but not the prior value — acceptable for now per Cedrick's flag in the same sync; revisit with a separate tracking object only if the client asks to see reason history.

Open questions

No dedicated "previous status" field is being captured — Reactivate always targets Active regardless of whether the record was Banned or Paused. Confirmed acceptable in the sync (Taryn's suggestion, Kobi agreed) but not yet re-confirmed with the client.

NOTES

Provenance: none — raised directly by Kobi in the Sept 2, 2026 Wagertech Internal Sync, not sourced from the Referrer Record User Stories doc.

SOURCE

*  Sept 2, 2026 Wagertech Internal Sync transcript.
*  Dependencies: [BUILD-232 — Referrer: Ban Button — Confirm Reason/Notes Capture](https://app.asana.com/0/0/1217801011390356/f/), [BUILD-235 — Referrer: Pause Button — Confirm Reason Capture](https://app.asana.com/0/0/1217800997934047/f/)
*  Owner (proposed): Taryn Reithofer
*  Created 2026-09-02 from the Wagertech Internal Sync transcript.
